root_idea.summary: The root centers on bringing elements together into an ordered whole, especially joining letters and words in connected recitation.
root_idea.development: From the notion of collecting or combining, the lexical field extends to reading or reciting connected words, the assembled revelation, teaching someone to recite, and periods understood as a joined transition between states.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Canonical Quran-attested Form IV causative verb.
Canonical Quran-attested noun and proper name for the revealed scripture, also used for its recitation.
Canonical Quran-attested plural nominal, presented under its supported singular citation form.

senses.definition: To read or recite connected words, writing, scripture, or a passage.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for reading or reciting aloud or from a text; with عَلَى, it can mean to recite something to someone. The Quranic forms include commands, active and passive predicates, and recitation of a specified text.

senses.definition: To cause or teach someone to read or recite.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which a teacher or instructor enables another person to read or recite, especially the revealed text.

senses.definition: The revealed Book or Scripture sent to Muhammad; the Quran as a written, uttered, and recited textual whole.
senses.usage_conditions: As a proper name it denotes the revealed scripture; the indefinite form can also denote a portion or presentation of that scripture. The name is associated lexically with a collected or recited revelation, though its etymology is disputed in the classical evidence.

senses.definition: Recitation or reading of the revelation.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun use is explicit in expressions such as its recitation and the recitation of dawn; in the interpretation of 75:17–18 it includes the gathering or fixing of the revelation and its subsequent recitation.

senses.definition: A menstrual onset or period, understood as the entry from a state of purity into menstruation.
senses.usage_conditions: One interpretation of ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ in 2:228 counts three such transitions into menstruation.

senses.definition: A period of purity from menstruation, or an interval between menstrual periods.
senses.usage_conditions: A second interpretation of ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ in 2:228 counts periods of purity rather than menstrual onsets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect, bring together, or join parts into a whole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary signification is stated for joining a thing part to part or portion to portion; this is broader Classical Arabic evidence, not a separate Quranic Form I translation sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to become pregnant, retain or enclose a fetus, bear, or cast forth a young one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported meanings vary with the construction and authority, covering pregnancy, retention of the fetus, birth, and expulsion of the young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To convey or deliver a salutation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially in the expression قَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ; another usage is associated with a written salutation and making it be read.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep a girl or woman in confinement while waiting for menstruation or the completion of a waiting period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The confinement is described as serving to establish freedom from pregnancy or to await the end of menstruation or ʿiddah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To read or study with another, each teaching the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To match or equal another in the time required for reading or recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a text or chapter compared with another according to the time needed to read it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to retain the male seed in the womb and enter the first stage of pregnancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is described particularly of a she-camel, ewe, or she-goat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to menstruate or to become pure from menstrual discharge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is reported with both contrary menstrual-state meanings; related expressions can denote seeing menstrual blood or becoming one who menstruates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of winds, to blow or begin to blow in their season.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of winds occurring at their appointed time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn back or return from a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach or draw near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person approaching a family, or of an object of need that is drawing near.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a star, to set, or for its time of setting to arrive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal use applied to stars and their setting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of stars, to delay bringing rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported astronomical or weather-related use, distinct from the star's setting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To postpone or delay something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of postponing an object of want or a promised entertainment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rhyme or versify.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in poetry, explained through the poetic sense of أَقْرَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To devote oneself to religious exercises, especially Quranic reading or recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived form can also mean to acquire religious or legal learning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To read or recite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is reported as synonymous with قَرَأَ in the relevant reading sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To investigate the modes, conditions, and properties of things; to examine a book for a particular item.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X investigative use, including systematic examination of a text.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a male camel, to leave a female after mating in order to determine whether she has conceived.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-breeding construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or require someone to read or recite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative-demand use of Form X.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time, season, or appointed period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the time at which an event, such as wind, occurs; this temporal branch is distinct from the menstrual interpretations represented under the Quranic plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rhyme, ending, mode, metre, or scope of a poem or verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic technical use, including the manner or species of verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A periodically recurring festival or feast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Synonymous with ʿīd in the cited lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A periodically recurring fever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical use, apparently referring to intermittent or recurrent fever.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something absent, becoming unapparent, or setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical use associated with disappearance or setting, including celestial setting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The period when a mare desires the stallion or is covered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-reproductive period, used in expressions describing the mare's state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The epidemic or common disease of a country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional term for the prevailing illness believed to affect newcomers to a region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The divinely appointed act of prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical extension based on prayer's inclusion of recitation; it is not asserted here as a Quranic lexical sense of the QAC noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or accomplished reader or reciter of the Quran.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal epithet; its regular plural is reported as قَرَّاؤُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A devotee who gives himself or herself to religious exercises, especially Quranic reading or recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form can also serve as a plural of قَارِئٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet applied to a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-specific use connected with the reproductive-period terminology of قَرْءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reader or reciter of the Quran.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle can also be used in the shortened form قَارٍ; its plurals include قَرَأَةٌ, قُرَّاءٌ, and قَارِئُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time when the wind blows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression وَقْتُ قَارِئِ الرِّيحِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The top or upper part of a pavilion or palace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized architectural meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The one among you most accomplished in reading or reciting the Quran.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can emphasize the greatest amount of recitation, or the soundest knowledge and strongest retention of the Quran.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who is menstruating or pure from menstrual discharge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participle preserves the two contrary menstrual-state interpretations reported for the underlying lexical field.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes or teaches another to read or recite, especially the Quran.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun for the instructional Form IV sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose menstruation is being awaited until its termination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive/intensive participial description connected with waiting out menstruation or its legal waiting period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Written material that is read or readable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a readable written sheet or document; variant forms are dialectal or irregular.

cautions: قُرُوءٌ in 2:228 has a genuine classical ambiguity between menstrual onsets or periods and periods of purity; both interpretations are recorded.
The classical evidence reports contrary reproductive-state meanings for several animal and menstrual constructions, so those meanings are not treated as interchangeable in Quranic usage.
The etymological relation of قُرْآنٌ to قَرَأَ is disputed in the cited tradition; the artifact distinguishes its recitation use from its proper-name use without resolving that dispute.
